name: Motorcycle
description: A motor-driven vehicle with a seat or saddle, designed to travel on no more than three wheels, that can go faster than 50 mph; a plug-in battery-powered one is an electric motorcycle.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle, and no more than three wheels on the ground (Kentucky Revised Statutes §§186.010(15), 189.285(6))
For registration, a top speed over 50 mph; a slower step-through one of 2 brake horsepower or more is a motor scooter, registered as a motorcycle (Kentucky Revised Statutes §186.010(15))
Kentucky's moped definition requires a combustion engine of 50 cc or less, so an electric moped-class vehicle can't be registered as a moped
Riders need a motorcycle operator's license, and must use approved eye protection (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.285)
Riders and passengers under 21, permit holders and riders licensed less than a year must wear an approved helmet (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.285)
A rider on an instruction permit may not carry passengers (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.285)
Titled and registered, and must carry insurance; a plug-in battery-powered one pays an annual electric motorcycle fee at registration
Needs a rear-view mirror (Kentucky Revised Statutes §189.285)
